## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.
- No Shell (definition not found in the record)

- No Env (definition not found in the record)
- No Process (definition not found in the record)

## Function Play Gate

The steps of a gate played in a scratch clone of HEAD; one row per acceptance run.

Behaviour: src/gate/playGate.ts. playGate({root, cards, steps, stubDir, refDir}, deps {env, now, timeoutMs?, before?}) → Promise<Play Row[]>; stubDir and refDir absolute; deps.after? (scratch, rows) → Promise<void>. base = fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir()/"morph-gate-"), scratch = base/w: gitOk(root, ["clone", "-q", "--shared", "--no-checkout", root, scratch]); gitOk(scratch, ["checkout", "-q", "--detach", the trimmed output of gitOk(root, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])]) — the committed tree, never the working one. root/node_modules exists → a symbolic link scratch/node_modules to its real path, and "/node_modules\n" appended to scratch/.git/info/exclude (directory created): a link is no directory to a "node_modules/" ignore line. Then deps.before?.(scratch). Per step in order (its card by customId; none → skipped): each put entry copies <stubDir or refDir>/<target> to scratch/<target>, parents created; start = deps.now(); Run Acceptance(card.acceptance ?? "", scratch, {env: deps.env, timeoutMs: deps.timeoutMs}); seconds = Math.round((deps.now() − start) / 100) / 10. A stub step: v = Stub Verdict(log, expectedStage(acceptance ?? ""), targets, TREE_PROFILES' fileLine), probeBreaks = the lines of v.outside whose FIRST fileLine match (new RegExp each, in order) has a probe file (cards' isProbeFile) as group 1, once each, order kept, outside = the rest (issue #50, F1: a build error naming a probe file — the card's own or another card's — is the orchestrator's data, not an outside line); ok = exit !== 0 and v.stage === v.expected and v.outside empty and probeBreaks empty; a ref or retry step: v = Stub Verdict(log, "", targets, the fileLines, null) (every stage), the same probeBreaks split of v.outside, ok = exit === 0. Row {phase, generation, card, exit, timedOut, seconds, stage: v.stage, expected: v.expected for a stub step else null, outside, failures: v.failures, probeBreaks, ok} — probeBreaks after failures, an empty list written, never omitted. Then a non-empty commit: gitOk(scratch, ["add", "-A", "-f", "--", ...commit]); gitOk(scratch, ["-c", "user.name=morph gate", "-c", "user.email=gate@morph.invalid", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "gate: <card>"]). After the last step, deps.after?(scratch, rows) is awaited (P22b: the mutants run there); base is removed in a finally; root's HEAD, refs, index and files are never touched.

- calls: Stub Verdict

- produces: Play Row

Data Play Row: One acceptance run of a gate play.
Schema:
{ phase: 'stub' | 'ref' | 'retry', generation: number, card: string, exit: number | null, timedOut: boolean, seconds: number, stage: string | null, expected: string | null, outside: string[], failures: string[], probeBreaks: string[], ok: boolean }

## Function Gate Command

`morph gate --deck <deck> --stubs <dir> --refs <dir>`: the gate played, one Gate Document.

Behaviour: src/gate/gateCommand.ts. CHAIN_LIMIT_SECONDS = 250 (exported). gateCommand(root, {deck, stubs, refs}, deps {env, now, timeoutMs?, readDeck, builds}) → Promise<{code, document}>; Main passes Read Deck File as readDeck and Check Builds as builds. In order: readDeck(root, deck) fails → its result. stubs then refs, path.resolve(root, v), not a directory → {code 4, document {error {code 4, kind "UsageError", message "stubs directory not found: <v>" | "references directory not found: <v>"}}}. generations = Layer Generations(deck); the regular files under each directory (links not followed), "/"-joined, sorted; plan = Gate Plan. plan.missing empty → rows = Play Gate({root, cards, steps, stubDir, refDir}, {env, now, timeoutMs, before: in the scratch, <dirname(deck)>/_stubs moved aside when present, the stub directory copied there, builds = deps.builds(scratch, deck, the deck, generations, env), the copy removed and the moved directory put back}); else rows [] and builds null. errors, in order: the missing; per build check "build <card>: no stub for <m>" per missing, "build <card>: <line>" per break; per row (prefix "<phase> <card>: "): a stub row with exit 0 "green on its stubs", else with stage ≠ expected "red at <stage or "no stage">, expected <expected>"; then per outside line "names a file outside its targets: <line>", then per probeBreaks line "probe does not build: <line>" (issue #50, F1: the gate fails a probe it cannot build by name, code 2, never as a silent row); a ref or retry row with exit ≠ 0 "timed out" | "red (exit <exit>)" + " at <stage or "no stage">" + (": " + its first outside line, when any); any row with seconds >= 250 "<seconds> s, over the 250 s limit". → {code: 2 when errors, else 0, document {deck, transaction, cards: the count, generations, missing, builds, rows, maxSeconds: the largest seconds (0 when none), errors}}, keys in that order. Mutants (P22b), only when args.mutants (a number, from `--mutants <n>`) is given, else nothing below happens and the document has no key mutants: deps may carry mutantTimeoutMs? and mutantStopSeconds?; Play Gate gets after(scratch, rows): planned = gate-proof's planGateMutants(deck.cards, read: the text of refDir/<target> when a regular file, else null, Math.min(args.mutants, MUTANT_CAP)); every ref and retry row ok → mutants = runGateMutants(scratch, deck.cards, planned, {env, now, timeoutMs: deps.mutantTimeoutMs, stopSeconds: deps.mutantStopSeconds}); else mutants = {planned: its length, tried 0, killed 0, timedOut 0, seconds 0, survivors [], untried: every planned spot {card, path, line, column, rule}, baselines []} (nothing run on red references). A missing file (no play) leaves mutants null. After the row errors, per baseline "mutants <card>: " + ("timed out" when timedOut, else "red (exit <exit>)") + " on its references without a mutant". document.mutants = mutants, the last key. code: 2 when errors; else 1 when mutants is not null and has a survivor or an untried mutant; else 0.

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.
- No Shell (definition not found in the record)
- No Clock (definition not found in the record)
- No Network (definition not found in the record)
- No Env (definition not found in the record)
- No Process (definition not found in the record)

Data Gate Document: stdout of morph gate.
Schema:
{ deck: string, transaction: boolean, cards: number, generations: string[][], missing: string[], builds: Build Check[] | null, rows: Play Row[], maxSeconds: number, errors: string[], mutants?: Gate Mutants | null }

Callee Gate Plan: The steps of a gate play, from a deck and the stub and reference files.
Behaviour: src/gate/gatePlan.ts, pure. gatePlan(cards, generations, stubs, refs) → {transaction, steps, missing}; stubs and refs are the paths of the files under the two directories. order = for every g, every id of generations[g] whose card exists, {card, generation g}. transaction = Transaction Deck's isTransactionDeck(cards). missing: per entry of order, per target, "no stub: <t>" when not in stubs, then "no reference: <t>" when not in refs, each once; missing not empty → steps []. A Gate Step is {phase "stub" | "ref" | "retry", generation, card, put: target → "stub" | "ref", commit: targets}. Not a transaction: per generation g in order, per its entries, two steps in a row: its {stub, put every target → "stub", commit []} immediately followed by its {ref, put every target → "ref", commit the targets} (stub a, ref a, stub b, ref b — never every stub first); after them, when g has two entries or more, per entry {retry, put {}, commit []}. A transaction: one stub step per entry (the first puts every target of every entry → "stub", each once, order kept; the others put {}), then one ref step per entry (the first puts them all → "ref"; the last commits them all), no retry.

Callee Play Gate: The steps of a gate played in a scratch clone of HEAD; one row per acceptance run.
Behaviour: src/gate/playGate.ts. playGate({root, cards, steps, stubDir, refDir}, deps {env, now, timeoutMs?, before?}) → Promise<Play Row[]>; stubDir and refDir absolute; deps.after? (scratch, rows) → Promise<void>. base = fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir()/"morph-gate-"), scratch = base/w: gitOk(root, ["clone", "-q", "--shared", "--no-checkout", root, scratch]); gitOk(scratch, ["checkout", "-q", "--detach", the trimmed output of gitOk(root, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])]) — the committed tree, never the working one. root/node_modules exists → a symbolic link scratch/node_modules to its real path, and "/node_modules
" appended to scratch/.git/info/exclude (directory created): a link is no directory to a "node_modules/" ignore line. Then deps.before?.(scratch). Per step in order (its card by customId; none → skipped): each put entry copies <stubDir or refDir>/<target> to scratch/<target>, parents created; start = deps.now(); Run Acceptance(card.acceptance ??
